_hypothesis: champion calibration uses group_by=source_class (skill_pooled=0.198, coverage_in=0.719), but group_by=instrument_class (exp_001) gave higher coverage (0.758) but lower skill (0.178), and both single-group (gpu_model, exp_004) and single-group (instrument_class) had drawbacks. Hybrid groupings haven't been tried; many miscalibrated series are under-covered within their source_class, suggesting more granular yet not too fine grouping may correct. -> Calibrating by group_by=series_id (most granular allowed) will increase coverage toward target (0.80) for under-covered series (e.g., afhubbard|hyperscaler_spot: above_q90=0.078, below_q10=0.042, y_above_q50=0.26), at the probable cost of reduced skill due to noisier adjustment, but may help worst-off groups. Change: Switch calibrate.group_by: 'series_id' instead of 'source_class'.
